hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for prediction market pools that gates swaps on a backend-signed VALS (Volatility-Adjusted Liquidity Spread) sigma parameter per swap. Computes an exponential fee (e^[λ·(Δx/L)·σ]−1) captured via BeforeSwapDelta and routed to share token holders through a YieldDistributor, while tracking LP positions and updating YES/NO prediction market prices after each pool action.
